speaker.basis: settled 2026-10-02 from fresh-translation review: Empire/Sidereal rank-and-file pilot: duty as soldier of the Empire, follows the Emperor and Supreme Commander, 'we Sidereal', scorns Earthlings; no personal name

proposed_by_v_g122_00.basis: Empire/Sidereal rank-and-file pilot: duty as soldier of the Empire, follows the Emperor and Supreme Commander, 'we Sidereal', scorns Earthlings; no personal name

proposed_by_v_g122_01.basis: Sidereal soldier: says Sidereal is immortal, cries out for Captain and His Majesty, calls Z-BLUE rebels and Earthlings, galaxy frontier; not Gyunei Guss/Jagd Doga, differs from Jigoku

proposed_by_v_g122_02.basis: Generic New Earth Empire soldier: swears by the Emperor and the Empire, calls the enemy Earthlings, defends Ra's Babylon, covers a Supreme Commander; male (ore). Jigoku's Gyunei Guss is wrong

proposed_by_v_g122_03.basis: Matches Jigoku (Jagd Doga); finished g122 lines are curt military/gnat-swatting, 'Pathetic, Gundam!'; these melee barks fit

122:430.en: 「I'll teach you how foolish you are!」

122:506.en: 「Defy us and you'll get no mercy!」

122:719.en: 「There's no place for you on Earth!」

122:758.en: 「We purge those who defy the Emperor!」

122:872.en: 「We crush the enemies of the Empire!」

122:1060.en: 「This battle,\nHis Majesty is watching it too!」

122:1375.en: 「Run and I'll shoot you in the back!」

122:1448.en: 「If I can just get in close!」

122:1519.en: 「I'll show you the gap in our skill!」

122:1567.en: 「If I charge in all at once!」

122:1681.en: 「I'll make a name downing a Gundam!」

122:2130.en: 「I won't lose to a custom-made\nclockwork doll!」

122:2183.en: 「Even if a child is piloting,\nI won't hold back!」

122:2556.en: 「The sun belongs to us, $$サイデリアル$$!」

122:2593.en: 「The sun shines for $$サイデリアル$$!」

122:2636.en: 「A robot that wields the sun's power!」

122:2667.en: 「A $$ギシン星$$ robot is\nsiding with Earth?!」

122:2741.en: 「I can't fall for their sweet talk!」

122:2776.en: 「To see a $$ビアル星$$ robot\nin a place like this!」

122:2899.en: 「Why is a $$マシンキャリバー$$ here\non the galaxy's frontier?!」

122:2952.en: 「So confident in air combat, I see!」

alternatives: I'll swat you down, you little gnat!

122:3065.en: 「Don't think an AT can beat me!」

122:3215.en: 「What can such a tiny unit do?!」

122:3293.en: 「That's the rumored $$熱気バサラ$$ and\n$$Ｆｉｒｅ　Ｂｏｍｂｅｒ$$!」

122:3350.en: 「Damn! Am I having a bad dream?!」

122:3393.en: 「What is that?! What the hell is it?!」

122:3475.en: 「I take it my opponent is their ace!」

122:3508.en: 「Down the ship and the battle's won!」

122:3545.en: 「Aim for the bridge or power section!」

122:3586.en: 「Earth's $$スフィア・リアクター$$, huh!」

122:3623.en: 「All $$スフィア$$ power shall\nbelong to $$サイデリアル$$!」

122:3958.en: 「Run and I'll shoot you in the back!」

122:3989.en: 「I won't miss my chance to counter!」

122:4171.en: 「Allow me to join in as well!」

122:4275.en: 「I'm honored to be the shield of\nHis Majesty the Emperor!」

122:4508.en: 「I'll fulfill the role I was given!」

122:4545.en: 「I leave the finishing blow to you!」

122:4699.en: 「Not good! I can't counter like this!」

122:4736.en: 「What humiliation!\nI can only watch the enemy go?!」

122:4914.en: 「If I don't move, the next one hits!」

122:5209.en: 「Not as good as the rumors, $$ガンダム$$!」

122:5242.en: 「Is this all a $$ガンダム$$ is?!」

122:5339.en: 「Your best in a weak unit, for this!?」

122:5382.en: 「Super Robot? Not worthy of the name!」

122:5425.en: 「However strong you are,\nI'm fine if I avoid a direct hit...!」

122:5538.en: 「I'll just stop it with my field!」

122:5728.en: 「Just a scratch! The mission goes on!」

122:5866.en: 「I can't worry over a little damage!」

122:6161.en: 「Damn! You're just a bunch of rebels!」

122:6194.en: 「Not bad, but this is it for you!」

122:6557.en: 「Strong!\nA $$ガンダム$$ and its pilot's power!」

122:6825.en: 「With this unit,\nI can't keep up with that speed!」

122:7011.en: 「Super Robot, my foot! Cut it out!」

122:7054.en: 「That $$マシンキャリバー$$ is different!」

122:7189.en: 「So this is the power of a $$スフィア$$!」

122:7362.en: 「A-a situation like this\nwasn't in the plan...!」

122:7444.en: 「I'll take that one down with me!」

122:7563.en: 「I-I have to admit it...!\nThis one is strong!」

122:7676.en: 「No good!\nLike this, I'm just waiting to die!」

122:7848.en: 「Why, out on the galaxy's frontier,\nis this happening to me...?!」

122:8025.en: 「Impossible! Me, in a spot like this!」

122:8180.en: 「No use! I have to abandon the unit!」

122:8392.en: 「Payback for siding with $$サイデリアル$$...!」
